events.title: Creators play the Lanternfall demo
events.summary: We've been blown away watching people play the Lanternfall demo, so we wanted to share three of our favourite videos. events.title: WON: £50 first-to-finish prize - congratulations VampyrX!
events.summary: This prize has been won! VampyrX was the first player to survive all four realms of the demo, with a replay-verified score of 849,956 at 23:51 UK time on 9 October 2026. The competition is now closed and the game no longer offers the prize. Congratulations, VampyrX - and thank you to everyone who took on the challenge. events.title: Demo update: clearer Energy, easier building, and helpful fixes
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who has been playing the demo and sharing feedback! This update makes a few useful controls easier to discover and clears up some of the battlefield UI. Choose how you build The first time you click an empty foundation, you can now choose between Quick Build and the full Tower Shop. You'll see a preview of each, and the game remembers your choice.
